## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Component
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Template
- [ ] CI/tooling
- [ ] Accessibility

## Testing

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run pack:check`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser`
- [ ] Tested affected behavior on mobile
- [ ] Tested keyboard interaction where relevant
- [ ] Tested reduced-motion behavior where relevant

## Accessibility

- [ ] Semantic HTML used where possible
- [ ] Focus remains visible
- [ ] Pointer interaction has a keyboard equivalent
- [ ] Motion is non-essential or has a reduced-motion path

## Package impact

- [ ] No package impact
- [ ] Package contents checked
- [ ] Version/release metadata updated when required

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private data added
- [ ] No unrelated redesign or generated files added
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior or API changed
